name: Magis Sparkmantle
summary: In Kharanos, Magis Sparkmantle trains gnome mages inside the Thunderbrew Distillery. He guides fledgling spellcasters who travel from Coldridge Valley into Dun Morogh.

sections.title: A Spellcaster in the Distillery
sections.body: Dwarves gather at the Thunderbrew Distillery for ale, and Magis Sparkmantle teaches among its casks and kegs. Gnome mages work closely with their dwarven allies across Dun Morogh. Magis helps novice spellcasters deepen their knowledge of the arcane and put it into practice.

sections.title: Directing Young Arcanists
sections.body: Magis teaches beginners their first incantations and points promising students toward wider circles of magic. When they outgrow his early lessons or need specialized guidance, he sends them to other practitioners, including Bink, or to mentors in the Alliance’s main hubs.

faq.answer: Magis Sparkmantle trains gnome mages in Kharanos, teaching novice spellcasters the fundamentals of the arcane.

faq.q: Where can Magis Sparkmantle be found?
faq.answer: You can find Magis inside the Thunderbrew Distillery, Kharanos’s main inn and gathering hall.

faq.q: Why is a gnome mage trainer staying in a dwarven distillery?
faq.answer: After the fall of Gnomeregan, many gnomes settled among their dwarven cousins in Dun Morogh. The Thunderbrew Distillery is Kharanos’s central gathering place, making it a good post for Magis to guide wandering spellcasters.

faq.q: Does Magis Sparkmantle offer any quests?
faq.answer: Magis sends developing mages to other arcane mentors as their studies advance, including Bink and instructors in human territories.

angles.text: As an Alliance mage traveling through Dun Morogh, you can turn to Magis for spell training and referrals to wider circles of arcane study.
As a gnome living among the dwarves, you can look to mentors like Magis to keep your scholarly and arcane traditions alive.
